title: Synaptic Provider Runtime Binding v1
description: Structural schema. The shared durable binding contains only a commitment to a provider-specific, independently retained and authenticated facts document. It never embeds provider-native deployment facts, environment maps, secret references, or secret values. Canonical parsing additionally verifies digest bindings, NFC text, and exact built-in value types.

provider_facts_schema.description: Versioned identity of the provider-adapter-owned closed facts schema; never a URI.

opaqueRef.description: Opaque identity material; not a path, URL, or value-bearing environment entry.
